item.title: Top Pick: Panera Bread: BOGO5: Second Entree for $5
item.description: Enter code BOGO5 at checkout online or in the app to get a second full-size soup, salad, or sandwich for just $5 when you buy one entree; free MyPanera account required. (Limited time)

item.title: Top Pick: Subway: Any Footlong for $6.99
